newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch.

text.p: * McDonnell Douglas Corp and Boeing Co were both quoted sharply higher in trading ahead of the U.S. stock market open after Sunday's announcement of a $13 billion merger, traders said.
McDonnel Douglas was traded at 64 on the Instinet system after closing at 52 on Friday. Boeing traded at 105, up from Friday's close of 96-3/4.

* Coca-Cola shares rose 1/4 to 48-1/8 in London after reports that the soft drink giant's introduction of a new soda in the United States next month could be its biggest soft drink launch since Diet Coke.
* High tech shares rebounded in London after Friday's broad sell-off in the sector.
International Business Machines Corp was up 3/8 at 152-3/4, Intel Corp, was up 1/2 at 132-7/8, Texas Instruments Inc was up 1/4 at 65-3/4, and Digital Equipment Corp was up 1/4 at 39-1/4.
* RenaissanceRe Holdings Ltd said it was repurchasing $100 million of its common shares through two transactions. Shares closed at 32-3/4 on Friday.
* U.S. Surgical Corp said it had cut its cash takeover offer for Circon Corp to $17 a share from $18 and had extended the offer through 1800 EST/2300 GMT February 13.
